examples.title: Basic table
examples.description: GhostDataTableTable renders headers, sort buttons, and rows from typed columns, with a custom currency cell and GhostPagination.

examples.title: Full composition
examples.description: Manual GhostTable composition with sort buttons, row selection, expandable detail rows, a global search, and an empty state.

examples.title: Pagination
examples.description: Manual GhostTable composition with a co-located GhostPagination bound to the root's pagination, pageCount, and setPageIndex slot bindings; searching clamps the page.

examples.title: Server data with URL state
examples.description: Server sorting, filtering, and paging synced to the URL: hydrates from the query string, pushes one history entry per committed query, ignores stale responses after Back, and recovers with retry().
